annotations.text:
Four directions for Onsen's polish pass.

Same tokens throughout — warm near-black #14120f, ink #e8e2d6, red #c0503c, blue #5b7fa6, Spectral for prose. What changes is the bet, not the palette.

Static mockups, for picking a direction.

MANUSCRIPT — the current thesis, actually committed. Speaker names hang in the left margin; the machinery moves to the right margin in the blue pencil. The wasted desktop width becomes margin that holds something.
WORKBENCH — accept it's a power tool with 200 endpoints. Three panes, ⌘K instead of a 19-button sheet, and four inspector tabs instead of thirty-one section labels.
ROOM — faces. A presence strip showing who is on stage and who has gone quiet, an avatar beside every voice, warmer ground. Closest to what the SillyTavern audience already knows.
THREAD — play-by-post, which is where roleplay actually comes from. Not precious: solid header bars, real buttons, alternating post rows, a quick-reply box. Chrome that admits it is chrome.
